news.h: Panthers RT Taylor Moton to undergo season-ending ankle surgery
news.d: Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton will undergo season-ending ankle surgery while also recovering from a fractured fibula in his left leg.

news.h: Panthers RT Taylor Moton carted off field with fractured fibula
news.d: Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton left Sunday's matchup against the Buccaneers on a cart in the third quarter with a left ankle and fibula injury.
